summary: Tested Vue generale refactor: 6 clickable KPI cards, insights, detail drawers, period selector, and KPI consistency across 4 backend endpoints (fleet/stats, vehicle-comparison, trends, efficiency). Backend 17/17 passing after fixing one refactor regression in /api/export/pdf. Frontend all interactions working; header now shows 12 vehicules - 4 actifs - 2889 km matching backend total.

minor.issue: On COLD cache first-run with same from_date/to_date, totals drifted by 1.0-2.3 km (2883.7 vs 2884.7 vs 2886.0) because each endpoint independently called Navixy get_mileage with slightly different timing. After cache warm-up, all four returned identical values and consistency tests pass. Consider having vehicle-comparison/trends/efficiency reuse the cached mileage buckets from fleet/stats to guarantee <0.5km consistency on first call.

action_items: Optional (nice-to-have): share cached mileage data across compute_vehicle_comparison / compute_trends / compute_fleet_efficiency to guarantee <0.5km consistency on FIRST call (currently only after warm cache)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:612 was calling engine.compute_vehicle_comparison(h, tenant) with the old 2-arg signature after the refactor made it require (h, from_date, to_date, tenant). This broke /api/export/pdf with a 500 TypeError. Fixed in this iteration by passing from_date, to_date, tenant explicitly.

Each of the 4 endpoints (fleet/stats, vehicle-comparison, trends, efficiency) makes its own Navixy get_mileage call. On cold cache, minor drift (~1-2 km) occurs because ongoing trips advance between the near-simultaneous calls. Consider computing mileage once in a shared coroutine and passing the result down.

context_for_next_testing_agent: 17 backend tests including 5 new consistency tests (KPI parity across 4 endpoints for same date range). PDF export bug fixed in this iteration (server.py line 612 - compute_vehicle_comparison signature). Cold-cache mileage drift is a soft issue - documented but not blocking. Detail drawer, KPI cards, insights all wired with data-testids ready for future regression.
rca_of_the_issue: PDF export 500: /api/export/pdf handler still used the pre-refactor call `engine.compute_vehicle_comparison(h, tenant)` while the engine method now requires `(h, from_date, to_date, tenant)`. Reproduced with pytest test_export_pdf -> 500. Fixed by supplying from_date/to_date. Backend logs confirmed: `TypeError: AnalyticsEngine.compute_vehicle_comparison() missing 2 required positional arguments: 'to_date' and 'tenant'`.
